question: Regarding terminal sedation, point out the INCORRECT response:

options.opa: It is indicated in patients who are close to his death.
options.opb: It should be used to relieve symptoms refractory to conventional treatments.
options.opc: It is not indicated when the terminal patient requests it, citing existential reasons.
options.opd: It should be used even if it is suspected that it will be responsible for shortening the patient's life.
